title: Noodling Nautilus
statement: Bobbing gently through a sunlit grotto of stacked slate and swaying sea-ferns, this opalescent cephalopod spends its days sorting colorful shards of sea glass into intricate, ever-shifting mosaics on the sandy floor. Whenever a visitor leans close, it pauses its tinkering to ripple warm, bioluminescent constellations across its shell and release a cheerful little chime of bubbles.
